rationale: Already decided by DEC-0142 (on main): after a rebase changes the patch-id the executor runs the hand review path (three Claude-native reviewers on git diff origin/main...HEAD, verdicts, emit leaves at the current patch-id, lease-push so check-attestation-sign signs, flip ready). leaves-rebind would reuse leaves for a diff nobody reviewed; DEC-0142 refuses that. Operational: dispatch applies .ai-sdlc/dispatch/notes/hand-review-path.md as the resume note. Event files for DEC-0156 are committed in the AISDLC-800 branch by the executor, not via a parent filing PR.
